clues: This is a city in Taiwan. It sits right next to the city of Taipei.
Rain falls here very often. The rain is a big part of life in this sea port town.
In 1626, men from Spain built a strong fort here. The land was home to Taiwan's first peoples.
In 1984, it ranked as the seventh largest port in the whole world. Few ports on Earth were bigger.
The key mark is Fort San Salvador. Spain set up this fort here, in this port city.
